# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting internet culture through Know Your Meme's viral trend encyclopedia and Scientific American's science journalism.

This site combines meme documentation from platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and DeviantArt with scientific content subscriptions. The primary focus appears to be tracking viral trends, exploitable memes, and cultural phenomena across social media.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Dance memes
- Twitter/X culture
- Catchphrases
- Nostalgia memes
- Hood movie references
- DeviantArt content
- YouTube trends
- Heartbreaking memes
- Rap song memes
- 90s cultural references

## TikTok & Social Media Trends

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl/cat art, viral on TikTok and Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
